scopes.name: Selective demolition
scopes.text: Remove ceilings, the spiral stair, mezzanine railing and part of the BOH wall in the conveyor zone. Salvage and store shelving. Protect the sales floor, slab and beams.

scopes.name: Structural steel and grid
scopes.text: MP-2 platform and supports, independent ceiling support grid, access ladder, gate and guards. Grid redesign by the engineer may change the scope.

scopes.name: Fire sprinkler
scopes.text: Delegated sprinkler design and alteration: upper line relocations before the conveyor, lower lines and the under-mezzanine system after. Needs the fire sprinkler permit.

scopes.name: Fire alarm
scopes.text: Fire alarm interface by the landlord-required vendor: bypass and fire watch, shop drawings, devices and acceptance tests.

scopes.name: Electrical
scopes.text: Make-safe and lighting removal, conveyor and door power, lighting, testing.

scopes.name: Drywall and ceilings
scopes.text: Partitions, gypsum ceilings and carpentry, door backing, rated walls, and lowering the storefront hard-lid ceiling during the install.

scopes.name: Paint and finishes
scopes.text: Paint and base, flooring repair and transitions, parquet protection, wallcovering and upper window film.

scopes.name: Mechanical / HVAC
scopes.text: Ductwork alteration in the conveyor zone, balancing and BMS tie-in.

scopes.name: Plumbing
scopes.text: Water and rain piping reroutes in the conveyor zone. Reroute design still to be issued.

scopes.name: Fireproofing restore
scopes.text: Restore beam fireproofing at the conveyor clamp points. Count may change with the grid redesign.

scopes.name: Scan, core and cut
scopes.text: GPR scan of the slab, cores and saw-cuts, patching.

scopes.name: Low voltage
scopes.text: Data, WAP, CCTV and RFID cabling.

scopes.name: Pickup door and window
scopes.text: Pickup door, frame, track, hardware and glazing, and the automatic sliding pickup window operator.

scopes.name: Receiving and storage
scopes.text: Receiving, storage and delivery to site.

phases.label: Design: sprinkler design and calcs (best case 11/25, worst 12/1)

Sprinkler shop drawings and fire permit
Overlap: storefront window wall lowering for conveyor (ceiling work TBD)
